components.heading: Provisions considered as continuation of existing ordinances.
components.text: The provisions appearing in this code, as far as they are the same as those of the ordinances existing at the time of the adoption of this code, shall be considered as a continuation thereof and not as new enactments. (Code 1981 § 1-24. Code 1995 § 1-10.)
